claim_boundary.claim_if_null: Stage 27C/27D class-local head and slice covers remain valid, but single-coordinate cover decomposition did not recover held-out hard-partner readout margins under the preregistered controls.
claim_boundary.claim_if_pass: Within the Stage 27C per-class Pythia-160M attention-head covers, sparse single-coordinate sets recover held-out hard-partner readout margins above matched random coordinate controls.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claims: Do not claim exact neurons, complete circuits, MLP-neuron localization, raw CAS-symbol understanding, an internal CAS compiler, Noetic/40-Element component causality, free-form generation control, or cross-model component generality from Stage 27E.
claim_boundary.scope_boundary: Stage 27E is bounded to single coordinates of pre-output-projection attention-head vectors inside the Pythia-160M Stage 27C Foundation covers. These coordinates are not literal neurons. Stage 27E is not an MLP-neuron claim, complete circuit, token sonar, Noetic/40-Element coverage, raw CAS-symbol understanding, or generation control.

formal_anchor: Refined local-cover framing: Stage 26/27A gives a global head cover, Stage 27C gives class-indexed head subcovers, Stage 27D gives within-head slice subcovers, and Stage 27E tests whether those covers admit single-coordinate subcovers.

gates.criterion: Stage 7 activation artifact hash matches the locked manifest.
gates.name: artifact_contract

gates.criterion: Stage 27C source report is PASS, uses the locked artifact, and exposes per-class covers over the selected six-head family.
gates.name: stage27c_contract

gates.criterion: Stage 27D source report is PASS and used single Stage 27C class-head covers as source context.
gates.name: stage27d_contract

gates.criterion: slices_per_head equals the 64-dimensional attention-head width; each candidate slice is one coordinate.
gates.name: single_coordinate_resolution

gates.criterion: Coordinate-cover learning rows come only from train split; scoring rows come only from test split.
gates.name: learn_eval_separation

gates.criterion: Per-class coordinate covers beat per-row random same-size coordinate-cover mean margin on at least 60% of eval rows with sign-test p<0.05.
gates.name: matched_random_coordinate_control

gates.criterion: At least 55% of eval rows have positive target-vs-hard-partner margin under the per-class coordinate cover.
gates.name: positive_margin_floor

gates.criterion: Mean coordinate-cover gain is at least 10% of the mean Stage 27C class-head-cover gain.
gates.name: head_cover_gain_fraction

method: Commit this pre-registration and runner before any Stage 27E GPU result is generated.
Refit the locked Stage 7 28-way Foundation probe on the locked layer-6 focus-token artifact.
Verify Stage 27C and Stage 27D are PASS with the locked artifact and selected six-head family.
Use Stage 27C per-class three-head covers as the candidate head set for each Foundation class.
Split each candidate head's 64-dimensional pre-output-projection vector into 64 single-coordinate slices.
Build a balanced coordinate-learning subset from Stage 7 train rows and a disjoint balanced evaluation subset from Stage 7 test rows.
For each learning row, globally ablate the six selected heads, then patch each candidate coordinate individually.
Score each candidate coordinate by target-vs-hard-partner Foundation probe-logit margin lift over the globally ablated state.
For each Foundation class, define an eight-coordinate class-local cover as the top coordinates by mean lift on learn rows for that class.
On held-out evaluation rows, compare class-local coordinate covers against same-size random coordinate covers sampled from the same class candidate heads.
Report the Stage 27C class-head cover and Stage 27D eight-dimensional slice-cover results as ceilings/context, not as primary controls.
motivation: Stage 27D narrowed class-specific Foundation readout evidence from per-class attention-head covers to contiguous within-head slices. Stage 27E tests the resolution limit: single head-coordinate covers.
